![What is a customer journey map? The complete overview ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-e712534cf480:4)
A [customer journey map](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map) is `a visual timeline that shows every step, action, emotion, and touchpoint a customer experiences when interacting with a brand, product, or service`.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/)[[2]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/software/customer-journey-map/)

### Core Components

- **Persona:** The specific customer profile, including their background, goals, and motivations.[[1]](https://miro.com/templates/customer-journey-maps/)[[2]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)
- **Stages:** The chronological phases a customer moves through (such as Awareness, Consideration, Purchase, Retention, and Advocacy).[[1]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-eyRiwXQw24&t=80)
- **Touchpoints:** The specific points of contact or channels where the customer interacts with the business (website, ads, physical store, or customer service).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eU8hqeC88jM&t=70)[[2]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)
- **Actions & Mindsets:** What the customer is trying to do, think, or decide at each phase.[[1]](https://coe.gsa.gov/2019/04/17/cx-update-9.html)[[2]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/)
- **Emotions & Pain Points:** The positive feelings or points of friction, confusion, and frustration the customer encounters.[[1]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)[[2]](https://coe.gsa.gov/2019/04/17/cx-update-9.html)
- **Opportunities:** Actionable solutions to fix friction and improve the overall experience.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/software/customer-journey-map/)[[2]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)

### Standard Stages of the Journey

1. **Awareness:** The customer realizes they have a need or problem and begins searching for information.
2. **Consideration:** The customer compares different options, reads reviews, and evaluates solutions.
3. **Decision / Purchase:** The customer selects a product or service and completes the transaction.
4. **Retention / Onboarding:** The customer starts using the product and interacts with customer support or community resources.
5. **Advocacy:** The customer becomes loyal, leaves reviews, or recommends the brand to others.[[1]](https://www.techtarget.com/enterprise-software/definition/What-is-a-customer-journey-map)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-eyRiwXQw24&t=80)[[3]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)

### How to Create One

- **Define Goals:** Establish clear, measurable objectives for what the map should achieve.[[1]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/customer-journey-map)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eU8hqeC88jM&t=70)
- **Research Customers:** Gather real data, user interviews, and surveys instead of relying on internal team assumptions.[[1]](https://www.smaply.com/blog/customer-journey-map)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/software/customer-journey-map/)
- **Map the Timeline:** Plot out stages, customer actions, thoughts, and emotional highs and lows.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/)[[2]](https://miro.com/templates/customer-journey-maps/)
- **Analyze & Act:** Identify gaps in the experience and assign team ownership to fix pain points.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/)[[2]](https://www.smaply.com/blog/customer-journey-map)

For more detailed guides and frameworks, see industry insights from [Nielsen Norman Group](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/) and [Forbes Advisor](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/software/customer-journey-map/).[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/customer-journey-mapping/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/software/customer-journey-map/)If you'd like, let me know:

- What **product or service** you are mapping for
- Your **primary goal** (reducing churn, increasing sales, improving onboarding)

I can help draft a custom stage-by-stage outline for your business.
